from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, glob, os, json
ff = sorted(glob.glob("/tmp/work/filter/filter/filter*"), key=lambda p: int(''.join(c for c in os.path.basename(p).split('.')[0] if c.isdigit())))
for f in ff:
    im = Image.open(f)
    info = {"file": os.path.basename(f), "size": im.size, "mode": im.mode, "format": im.format}
    has_alpha = im.mode in ("RGBA","LA","PA") or ("transparency" in im.info)
    info["has_alpha_flag"] = bool(has_alpha)
    rgba = im.convert("RGBA")
    a = np.array(rgba)
    alpha = a[...,3]
    info["alpha_min"] = int(alpha.min()); info["alpha_mean"] = round(float(alpha.mean()),1)
    rgb = a[...,:3].astype(float)
    lum = rgb.mean(axis=2)
    info["lum_mean"] = round(float(lum.mean()),1)
    info["lum_median"] = round(float(np.median(lum)),1)
    info["pct_dark(<40)"] = round(float((lum<40).mean()*100),1)
    info["pct_bright(>200)"] = round(float((lum>200).mean()*100),1)
    # border sample
    b = np.concatenate([lum[0,:], lum[-1,:], lum[:,0], lum[:,-1]])
    info["border_lum_mean"] = round(float(b.mean()),1)
    # saturation
    mx = rgb.max(axis=2); mn = rgb.min(axis=2)
    sat = np.where(mx>0, (mx-mn)/np.maximum(mx,1), 0)
    info["sat_mean"] = round(float(sat.mean()),3)
    print(json.dumps(info))
`;

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# Detect baked-in checkerboard: look for a regular alternating grid of two gray values
def checker_score(path):
    im = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
    a = np.array(im).astype(float)
    lum = a.mean(axis=2)
    h,w = lum.shape
    best = None
    for block in (4,5,6,7,8,10,12,16):
        # compare mean of "even" blocks vs "odd" blocks
        ys = (np.arange(h)//block)%2
        xs = (np.arange(w)//block)%2
        mask = (ys[:,None] ^ xs[None,:]).astype(bool)
        d = abs(lum[mask].mean() - lum[~mask].mean())
        if best is None or d > best[1]:
            best = (block, d)
    return best

import glob, os
ff = sorted(glob.glob("/tmp/work/filter/filter/filter*"), key=lambda p: int(''.join(c for c in os.path.basename(p).split('.')[0] if c.isdigit())))
for f in ff:
    im = Image.open(f)
    real_alpha = im.mode in ("RGBA","LA") or "transparency" in im.info
    b,d = checker_score(f)
    print(f"{os.path.basename(f):16s} mode={im.mode:5s} size={str(im.size):14s} realAlpha={str(real_alpha):5s} checker(block={b}, delta={d:.2f})")
`;

import zipfile, shutil, re, os, sys

SRC = "/home/user/Desktop/weather_of_hongkong.pptx"
BAK = "/tmp/work/weather_of_hongkong.BACKUP.pptx"
TMP = "/tmp/work/out.pptx"
DESK = "/home/user/Desktop/"

if not os.path.exists(BAK):
    shutil.copy2(SRC, BAK)
    print("backup ->", BAK)

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(BAK, "r")

# --- template: copy slide3's picture background verbatim, only change alpha ---
s3 = zin.read("ppt/slides/slide3.xml").decode("utf-8")
tpl = re.search(r"<p:bg>.*?</p:bg>", s3, re.S).group(0)
print("template BG:", tpl)
newbg = tpl.replace('amt="50000"', 'amt="60000"')   # 40% transparency => 60% alpha
assert 'amt="60000"' in newbg, "alpha replace failed"
assert 'r:embed="rId3"' in newbg, "unexpected rId in template"
print("new BG     :", newbg)

s3r = zin.read("ppt/slides/_rels/slide3.xml.rels").decode("utf-8")
relm = re.search(r'<Relationship Id="rId3"[^>]*/>', s3r).group(0)
print("template REL:", relm)

jobs = {
    5: ("hk_rainy_pic3&filter5.png", "image5.png"),
    6: ("hk_snowy_pic3&filter4.png", "image6.png"),
}

patched = {}
for n,(desk_name, media_name) in jobs.items():
    # ---- slide xml ----
    d = zin.read(f"ppt/slides/slide{n}.xml").decode("utf-8")
    if "<p:bg>" in d:
        d2 = re.sub(r"<p:bg>.*?</p:bg>", newbg, d, count=1, flags=re.S)
    else:
        assert "<p:cSld><p:spTree>" in d, f"slide{n}: unexpected cSld layout"
        d2 = d.replace("<p:cSld><p:spTree>", "<p:cSld>" + newbg + "<p:spTree>", 1)
    assert d2 != d and 'amt="60000"' in d2, f"slide{n} bg patch failed"
    patched[f"ppt/slides/slide{n}.xml"] = d2.encode("utf-8")

    # ---- rels ----
    rl = zin.read(f"ppt/slides/_rels/slide{n}.xml.rels").decode("utf-8")
    assert 'Id="rId3"' not in rl, f"slide{n}: rId3 already used"
    newrel = relm.replace("image3.png", media_name).replace("image4.png", media_name)
    assert media_name in newrel, "rel target rewrite failed: " + newrel
    rl2 = rl.replace("</Relationships>", newrel + "</Relationships>")
    patched[f"ppt/slides/_rels/slide{n}.xml.rels"] = rl2.encode("utf-8")
    print(f"slide{n} rel ->", newrel)

    # ---- media ----
    patched[f"ppt/media/{media_name}"] = open(DESK + desk_name, "rb").read()

# --- rebuild zip preserving order + untouched bytes ---
names = zin.namelist()
added = set()
zout = zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
for item in zin.infolist():
    if item.filename in patched:
        zout.writestr(item, patched[item.filename]); added.add(item.filename)
    else:
        zout.writestr(item, zin.read(item.filename))
for k,v in patched.items():
    if k not in added:
        zout.writestr(k, v); print("added new entry:", k, len(v))
zout.close(); zin.close()

# sanity: content types already declares png
ct = zipfile.ZipFile(TMP).read("[Content_Types].xml").decode("utf-8")
assert 'Extension="png"' in ct, "png default missing"
shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print("WROTE", SRC, os.path.getsize(SRC))
`;
